text:
</sub>  Add an input for the version attestation

The follow-up now makes an operator-recorded version-attestation basis mandatory for admissible AC8/AC9 evidence, but the driver adds only `--sweep-mode`, `--runs`, and `--output-file`, and no planned config field supplies the attestation. Consequently, the prescribed campaign commands can only emit an absent/unattested value, which line 232 then declares inconclusive, unless the operator hand-edits generated evidence. Add a CLI/config input for the attestation, include it in the commands, and verify it is equal across paired arms.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 39febf3, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Plan PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews plan PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
